question: In India, who is regarded as the father of modern dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Uday Shankar is regarded as the Father of Modern Dance in India.
 
• Uday Shankar was an Indian dancer and choreographer
 
• He fused European theatrical techniques with Indian classical dance to create a unique style.
 
• His dance innovation influenced India, Europe, and the US in the 1920s and 1930s.
 
• In 1938, Uday Shankar founded the Uday Shankar India Culture Centre in __Almora, Uttaranchal (now Uttarakhand).
 
• Together with his brother, the sitarist Ravi Shankar, he explored classical and folk dance
 
• In 1962, he was awarded by Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance and Drama.
 
• In 1971, the Govt. of India, awarded him its second highest civilian award the Padma Vibhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam**

 
 
• The legend Vempati Chinna Satyam(15 October 1929 – 29 July 2012) was associated with the dance form Kuchipudi__.
 
• He is known to popularize the dance form worldwide.
 
• He is a recipient of several awards including Sangeet Peeth of Bombay and Raja Lakshmi Award of Madras.
 
 
 
• **Bipin Singh **
 
 
• Guru Bipin Singh is associated with Manipuri dance form.
 
• Manipuri is a classical dance form originated in the north-eastern state of Manipur.
 
• This dance form is known for its graceful movements, unique costumes, and use of props like cymbals, bamboo flutes, and drums.
 
• Guru Bipin Singh is considered as one of the pioneers of Manipuri dance and has contributed significantly to its growth and popularity.
 
 
 
• **Kelucharan Mahapatra​** 
 
 
• Kelucharan Mahapatra, Sonal Mansingh and Geeta Mahalik famous dancers of Odissi.
 
• Odissi, also referred to as Orissa in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that origin in the Hindu temples of Odisha – an eastern coastal state of India.
 
• Odissi Dance originates from the Indian state of Odisha.
 
• According to Natya Shastra, ‘Odhra Magadha’ is the earliest form of present-day Odissi Dance. 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight Indian Classical Dances.
